notes: WordPress-based listings page. Successfully extracts 10 listings per page with title, description, and date. Price information is embedded in the description text and needs parsing (e.g., 'AP $1.35 Million', '$1,125,000'). Location information is in title/description (VA, MD, Fairfax, etc.). Images available at img.wp-post-image selector but not extracted in text mode. URLs need to be extracted from href attributes via post-processing. Pagination available with 3+ pages. Mixed English/Korean content. Includes commercial real estate (retail buildings, office buildings) and restaurants/businesses.
